desc: Intimation of 52nd Annual General Meeting, E-voting and Fixation of Record Date for Final Dividend for FY 2025-26.

Pursuant to Regulation 42 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, Company has Fixed Sunday September 20, 2026 as Record Date for payment of Final Dividend, if approved at the Annual General Meeting for FY 2025-26.
